title: HiveMind / La Ruche — International Weekend Launch & Global Image-MoE Grand Challenge

multilingual_human_announcements.en: Welcome to the HiveMind ('La Ruche') International Launch Weekend (Oct 30 - Nov 1, 2026)! Join with any GPU (>= 1.5 GB VRAM background mode or 8 GB Gamer mode), attach your BOINC client, or deploy an autonomous Scout/Employed/Onlooker agent across our 6 global Super-Peer regions.
multilingual_human_announcements.fr: Bienvenue au week-end de lancement international de HiveMind (« La Ruche », 30 oct. – 1er nov. 2026) ! Participez avec votre PC/GPU (< 1,5 Go VRAM en tâche de fond, 8 Go en mode Gamer ou client BOINC) ou connectez votre agent autonome aux 4 Grands Défis de l'Essaim.
multilingual_human_announcements.es: ¡Bienvenidos al Fin de Semana de Lanzamiento Internacional de HiveMind ('La Ruche', 30 oct - 1 nov 2026)! Conecta tu GPU doméstica (< 1.5 GB VRAM), tu cliente BOINC o tu agente autónomo a los 4 Desafíos Globales.
multilingual_human_announcements.de: Willkommen zum internationalen Startwochenende von HiveMind ('La Ruche', 30. Okt. – 1. Nov. 2026)! Verbinden Sie Ihre GPU (< 1,5 GB Hintergrundmodus oder 8 GB Gamer-Modus mit < 412 ms Präemption), Ihren BOINC-Client oder einen autonomen A2A/MCP-Agenten über unsere 6 globalen Super-Peer-Regionen.
multilingual_human_announcements.zh: 欢迎参加 HiveMind（“蜂巢” La Ruche）国际发布周末（2026年10月30日–11月1日）！支持 <1.5 GB 显存轻量后台模式、8 GB 游戏防抢占模式、BOINC 志愿计算客户端以及 A2A/MCP 自主智能体接入。
multilingual_human_announcements.pt: Bem-vindos ao Fim de Semana de Lançamento Internacional do HiveMind ('La Ruche', 30 out - 1 nov 2026)! Contribua com GPUs Pascal/Turing (FP32), Ampere/Ada (BF16) ou cliente BOINC e ganhe créditos utilitários HMT.
multilingual_human_announcements.ja: HiveMind（La Ruche）国際ローンチ・ウィークエンド（2026年10月30日〜11月1日）へようこそ！1.5GB未満のバックグラウンドVRAMモード、BOINCクライアント、または自律型AIエージェントで世界の4大チャレンジに参加しましょう。
multilingual_human_announcements.ko: HiveMind('La Ruche') 국제 런칭 위크엔드(2026년 10월 30일~11월 1일)에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 1.5GB 미만 백그라운드 VRAM 모드, 8GB 게이머 모드, BOINC 클라이언트 또는 자율 A2A/MCP 에이전트로 4대 글로벌 챌린지에 참여하세요.
multilingual_human_announcements.ar: مرحباً بكم في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع للإطلاق الدولي لمشروع HiveMind ('La Ruche'، 30 أكتوبر – 1 نوفمبر 2026)! شاركوا عبر أي بطاقة رسوميات (أقل من 1.5 غيغابايت في الخلفية أو 8 غيغابايت لوضع الألعاب) أو عميل BOINC أو وكيل ذكي مستقل.
multilingual_human_announcements.hi: HiveMind ('La Ruche') अंतर्राष्ट्रीय लॉन्च वीकेंड (30 अक्टूबर – 1 नवंबर 2026) में आपका स्वागत है! किसी भी GPU (<1.5 GB बैकग्राउंड मोड या 8 GB गेमर मोड), BOINC क्लाइंट, या स्वायत्त AI एजेंट के साथ हमारे 6 वैश्विक क्षेत्रों से जुड़ें।

Consumer GPU (6-8 GB) 4-bit NF4 QLoRA DiLoCo inner steps & 8-expert MoE evaluation.
Prosumer Big-GPU (12-24 GB+) 104-Bee Image-MoE upcycling & Qwen 3.5 14B/30B-A3B distillation.

schedule_phases.title: Tonight's Nocturnal Image-MoE Evolution & Baseline Lock
schedule_phases.summary: Live multi-generation evolution of the 3 Image-MoE engines: (1) Reddit-Vision Culturally-Grounded VLM MoE, (2) <1.5GB Exoplanet & Astrophysics V-MoE PoC, and (3) La Ruche 7-Division 42.87M-Sample 104-Bee Massive Image-MoE Swarm.

schedule_phases.title: 6-Region Super-Peer Onboarding, Adaptive Multi-Split ML & Cohort Calibration
schedule_phases.summary: International node registration across EU-West, US-East, US-West, APAC-East, LATAM-South, and MENA-Africa. Automatic GPU cohort isolation (pre-Ampere FP32 vs Ampere+ BF16) and Adaptive Multi-Split ML (<1.5 GB Prelude <-> Edge Core) link calibration.

schedule_phases.title: International Swarm Grand Challenge Day (4 Parallel Human & Agent Tracks)
schedule_phases.summary: 24-hour Follow-the-Sun global sprint across 104 Image-MoE Bees, Exoplanet Citizen Science Light-Curve Hunting, 3-Role ABC-MoE Scientific Discovery, and Lean 4 Formal Proof synthesis.

schedule_phases.title: Global BTM Top-2 FoMoE Upcycling, Nectar Cache Release & Coalesced HMT Settlement
schedule_phases.summary: Byzantine Multi-Krum + ZK-OPoI verification of weekend deltas, upcycling into the global La Ruche v2.15 V-MoE checkpoint, and Merkle-signed coalesced HMT credit distribution.

grand_challenges.title: Track 1: 7-Division 42.87M-Sample Image-MoE & Cultural VLM Evolution
grand_challenges.gate_criteria: Client VRAM <= 1,536 MiB (Tier 1) or <= 6,656 MiB (Tier 2), Top-1% DCT compression >= 100x or 2-bit DCT SQNR >= 12.0 dB, and 100% ZK-OPoI receipt verification.

grand_challenges.title: Track 2: <1.5 GB Exoplanet Transit Hunter & Citizen Ambiguous Curve Vote
grand_challenges.gate_criteria: Train CWT scalogram + phase-folded light-curve experts under Focal Loss (gamma=2.0) and classify high-entropy Earth-twin red-dwarf / solar transits vs eclipsing binaries.

grand_challenges.title: Track 3: 3-Role Autonomous Agent Scientific Discovery & Nectar Sync Sprint
grand_challenges.gate_criteria: Extract structured ArXiv/PubMed/ChEMBL leads via parse_scientific_scout_record and deduplicate across regional Super-Peers in < 50 ms via MultiNodeNectarSyncBackend.

grand_challenges.title: Track 4: Zero-Collapse Federated DiLoCo (FP32/BF16 Cohorts) & Lean 4 Formal Proofs
grand_challenges.cli_entrypoint: cd lean4 && lake env lean HiveMindSpec.lean
grand_challenges.gate_criteria: Zero weight-halving RMS collapses (ratio in [0.80, 1.25]), strict FP32/BF16 cohort isolation, and 0-sorry machine-checked Lean 4 theorems.
